# By JTT Design

> By JTT Design is a public design standard, research system and Studio for people, designers, developers and AI agents building digital products from August 2026 onward.

## Canonical standard

- [By JTT Design Standard v0.1](https://design.byjtt.com/standard/): the canonical human-readable public standard.
- [Machine-readable standard index](https://design.byjtt.com/standard.json): structured discovery surface for agents and tooling.

## Product surfaces

- [Design Studio](https://design.byjtt.com/studio): browser workspace for describing a product, directing a design, inspecting evidence and publishing reusable work.
- [Design Contracts](https://design.byjtt.com/contracts/): portable, versioned product and design intent covering goals, brand, components, interaction, responsive behaviour, accessibility, rationale and provenance.
- [Resource Library](https://design.byjtt.com/library/): reusable resources recorded with decisions, evidence and provenance rather than screenshots alone.
- [Research](https://design.byjtt.com/research/): research into user needs, patterns, AI design failure modes, accessibility and design practice.
- [Benchmarks](https://design.byjtt.com/benchmarks/): controlled comparisons of design workflows using explicit methodology and limitations.
- [Documentation](https://design.byjtt.com/docs/): product and quality guidance.
- [Agent guidance](https://design.byjtt.com/agents/): practical guidance for agents consuming the standard and Design Contracts.

## Standard principles

- Human purpose before interface polish.
- Evidence before aesthetics.
- Intent over imitation.
- Real conditions are the design.
- Accessible by construction.
- Best solved system first.
- Production is the source of truth.
- Human agency with bounded autonomy.
- Provider independence.
- Provenance by default.

## AI and agent state model

The standard distinguishes, where applicable: suggested, generated, inspected, verified, executed and human-approved. Material autonomous actions should expose scope, rationale, evidence, uncertainty, permission boundaries and reversibility appropriate to risk.

## Evidence classes

ByJTT distinguishes observed evidence, inference and hypothesis. Do not describe generated output or heuristic review as verified evidence.

## Current implementation note

The current Studio vertical slice uses deterministic transformations while product and evidence contracts are validated. Production model adapters remain replaceable and should not be assumed from the public site.

## Source of truth

`STANDARD.md` is the canonical public standard. `PRODUCT.md`, `DESIGN.md`, requirements, research, benchmarks and Design Contracts provide supporting product, implementation and evidence context. Public pages and `standard.json` should expose or index this source rather than redefine it.
